history.justification: graded-reflex protocol re-pin (reflex null -> graded, issue #8125): the W3 harness now replays the REAL volunteer.decide reflex over EP-warmed cells instead of injecting nothing, so the standing kta / false-fire bars are LIVE rather than inactive. Deliverable of the EP warm-start (the named under-fire class: the echo lane's capture mints no claim/operator, so _promote_and_dream no-ops and every point read the Beta(1,1) neutral 0.5 under the reflex's 0.7 EP gate -- 4 of 4 know-to-ask turns missed at d1f2d345c): each graded cell gets the canonical #2199 system-default starting belief (Beta(3,1)) on its live belief points with no persisted prior, then the REAL EP pass. Measured on the frozen BPRE corpus (15 sessions, m2 echo lane, deterministic): know_to_ask_failure_rate 0.000, false_fire_rate 0.000 (epic #2080 indicator 3 / E2E-3 target met), write_back_fidelity 1.000, continuity_recall 1.000, source_isolation_violations 0 (E2E-4 gate green). push_precision/push_recall 0.000 are NOT an evaluable measurement and the push precision floor is NOT applied: the committed push gold names symbolic pointer ids (pt_lumen_boundary / pt_ember_flow) that no replay cell can mint, and each push session owns a cell containing only its own conversation, so pointer identity is ungradeable by construction -- disclosed in this run's notes, in the receipt (reflex_gate.push_bar_applied=false), and as a failure class in this history entry; fix-wave #9081 makes the gold graph-grounded and re-activates the floor. With the EP warm-start disabled the same lane reads know_to_ask_failure_rate 1.000 (REGRESSION), so the mechanism is load-bearing (can-fail test in test_harness_benchmark.py). baselines/main.json is unchanged: re-blessing the llm product lane needs a keyed run (#9082).
